meaning: The secure way a browser and a website talk. It scrambles the information so others cannot read it on the way.
clues: It is a set of letters you see at the start of some web addresses.
It is the safe way web pages travel between a website and your browser, so others can't read what you send.
It ends with an S, which stands for secure.
Browsers often warn you about pages that do not use it.
It has five letters and starts with H.
assumes: HTML is the code that builds a web page
FTP is a way to send files between computers
DNS turns website names into numbers

decoys.meaning: The code that sets up the words and pictures on a web page.
A way to send files between computers over a network.
The system that turns website names into the numbers computers use.
